ruleset.name: nitpicker
ruleset.description: Nitpicker's PMD categories for main and test sources.

rule.message: Field {0} has the same name as a method. Rename one of them; a method named exactly like its field with at most one parameter (an accessor, a fluent setter or builder step) is allowed. If it is right here, add an exception for pmd/AvoidFieldNameMatchingMethodName in nitpicker.config.json.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //FieldDeclaration[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static' and pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final')]/VariableDeclarator/VariableId [some $method in ../../..[self::ClassBody or self::EnumBody]/MethodDeclaration satisfies lower-case(@Name) = lower-case($method/@Name) and not(@Name = $method/@Name and $method/FormalParameters[@Size < 2])]

rule.message: Use a named constant instead of this literal in the condition (-1, 0, 1 and 2 are allowed). If it is not a magic number, add an exception for pmd/AvoidLiteralsInIfCondition in nitpicker.config.json.
Assign first, then use the variable. An assignment in a while condition is allowed. If it is right here, add an exception for pmd/AssignmentInOperand in nitpicker.config.json.

Pass values as placeholders (LOG.debug("user '{'}", user)) and compute nothing in the arguments; guard the call with isDebugEnabled() only when an argument must be computed. If it is right here, add an exception for pmd/GuardLogStatement in nitpicker.config.json.

property.name: violationSuppressXPath
property.value: ./MethodCall[ArgumentList/*[1][self::StringLiteral]] [not(ArgumentList/*[position() > 1][not( self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess or self::ThisExpression or self::StringLiteral or self::NumericLiteral or self::BooleanLiteral or self::CharLiteral or self::NullLiteral or (self::MethodCall[ArgumentList[@Size = 0]] [*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess or self::ThisExpression]]))])]

rule.name: LogStringConcatenation
rule.message: Pass values as placeholders (LOG.info("user '{'}", user); '{'0} in System.Logger and java.util.logging), not a message built with + or String.format. If it is right here, add an exception for pmd/LogStringConcatenation in nitpicker.config.json.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('info', 'warn', 'error', 'log', 'config', 'warning', 'severe')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.spi.LoggingEventBuilder') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.logging.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.System.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.commons.logging.Log')]] /ArgumentList/(*[1] | *[1][not(pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.String'))]/following-sibling::*[1]) [(self::InfixExpression[@Operator = '+'] and not(@CompileTimeConstant = true())) or self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('format', 'formatted')]]

rule.name: GeneratedOnHandWrittenCode
rule.message: JaCoCo and PIT skip code annotated @Generated, so this is not measured. Remove the annotation from hand-written code. If this file is generated, add an exception for pmd/GeneratedOnHandWrittenCode in nitpicker.config.json.

rule.name: ExhaustiveEnumPredicate
rule.message: These comparisons list only some constants of an enum of the project, so a constant added later silently falls into the other case. Classify every constant: a switch expression without default (adding a constant then fails to compile), or a boolean each constant declares (PAID(true)). If a partial test is intended, add an exception for pmd/ExhaustiveEnumPredicate in nitpicker.config.json.

property.name: xpath
property.value: ( //InfixExpression[@Operator = ('||', '&&')][not(parent::InfixExpression/@Operator = @Operator)] [let $root := ., $op := @Operator, $test := if ($op = '||') then '==' else '!=', $operands := descendant::*[not(self::InfixExpression[@Operator = $op])] [ancestor::*[not(self::InfixExpression[@Operator = $op])][1] is $root/..] [parent::InfixExpression[@Operator = $op]], $constants := $operands/FieldAccess[pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Enum')][TypeExpression], $subjects := $operands/*[not(self::FieldAccess[pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Enum')][TypeExpression])] return count($operands) >= 2 and (every $o in $operands satisfies $o[self::InfixExpression[@Operator = $test]] [count(FieldAccess[pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Enum')][TypeExpression]) = 1] [*[self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess[ThisExpression]]]) and count(distinct-values($subjects/@Name)) = 1 and count(distinct-values($constants/TypeExpression/ClassType/@SimpleName)) = 1 and count(distinct-values($constants/@Name)) = count($constants)] | //MethodCall[@MethodName = 'contains'][ArgumentList/@Size = 1] [*[1][self::MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.EnumSet#of(_*)')]] [ArgumentList/@Size >= 2] [every $c in ArgumentList/* satisfies $c[self::FieldAccess[TypeExpression]]]] ) [let $slot := ancestor-or-self::*[not(parent::UnaryExpression[@Operator = '!'])][1] return $slot/parent::ReturnStatement or $slot/parent::LambdaExpression or $slot/parent::VariableDeclarator or ($slot/parent::AssignmentExpression and not($slot/parent::*/*[1] is $slot))]

rule.name: StaticForwardingWrapper
rule.message: This static method only passes its parameters, in order, to another method. Call that method directly where this one is used and delete the wrapper. If the wrapper is intended (a public alias, or a name a framework looks up), add an exception for pmd/StaticForwardingWrapper in nitpicker.config.json.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static'][not(ModifierList/Annotation)][not(TypeParameters)] [not(@Name = ('main', 'valueOf', 'fromString'))] [FormalParameters/@Size > 0] [not(ancestor::*[self::ClassDeclaration or self::RecordDeclaration or self::EnumDeclaration]/ModifierList/Annotation [pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Component') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Service') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Repository') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Controller') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ControllerAdvice') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication')])] [let $method := ., $parameters := FormalParameters/FormalParameter/VariableId/@Name, $call := Block[count(*) = 1]/(ReturnStatement | ExpressionStatement[$method/VoidType])/MethodCall return exists($call) and not($call/TypeArguments) and ($call/*[1][self::TypeExpression] or ($call/*[1][self::ArgumentList] and $call/@MethodName != $method/@Name)) and $call/ArgumentList/@Size = count($parameters) and (every $i in 1 to count($parameters) satisfies $call/ArgumentList/*[$i][self::VariableAccess]/@Name = $parameters[$i])]

rule.name: SingularAndPluralMember
rule.message: A member and its plural (tag and tags) are two ways to pass the same data. Keep the plural and pass one item as a one-element list. If both are intended, add an exception for pmd/SingularAndPluralMember in nitpicker.config.json.

property.name: xpath
property.value: ( //RecordDeclaration/RecordComponentList/RecordComponent | //ClassDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties')]] /ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static')] ) [let $boxes := map { 'boolean': 'Boolean', 'byte': 'Byte', 'char': 'Character', 'short': 'Short', 'int': 'Integer', 'long': 'Long', 'float': 'Float', 'double': 'Double' }, $type := (ClassType | ArrayType | PrimitiveType)[1], $element := if ($type[self::ArrayType]) then $type/*[1] else $type[self::ClassType][@SimpleName = ('List', 'Set', 'Collection', 'Iterable', 'SortedSet')] /TypeArguments[count(*) = 1]/*[1], $plural := (VariableId | VariableDeclarator/VariableId)[1]/@Name return exists($element) and (some $other in ../(RecordComponent | FieldDeclaration[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static')]) satisfies let $name := ($other/VariableId | $other/VariableDeclarator/VariableId)[1]/@Name, $own := ($other/ClassType | $other/ArrayType | $other/PrimitiveType)[1], $ownName := if ($own[self::PrimitiveType]) then $boxes($own/@Kind) else $own/@SimpleName, $elementName := if ($element[self::PrimitiveType]) then $boxes($element/@Kind) else $element/@SimpleName return $plural = ($name || 's', $name || 'es', if (matches($name, '[^aeiou]y$')) then substring($name, 1, string-length($name) - 1) || 'ies' else ()) and $own[self::ClassType or self::PrimitiveType] and $ownName = $elementName)]
